term: innovating cause, cause of coming to be
definition: A cause other than the thing itself from which that thing’s coming to be takes its origin. CausesOrigin c x is the primitive relation for this source reading; the reading of SCG I.13 requires such a c for what comes to be anew. It does not identify the cause as God, identify it with moving in an arbitrary respect, or equate beginning with being present at a first instant.
